personality_one_liner: A highly functional, premium-feeling service marketplace that balances command-center utility with consumer-grade polish and trust.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing. Use safe areas at all root components. Thumb-friendly touch targets (min 44pt). Form inputs and cards need comfortable internal padding.

do's: Use glass for bottom tab bars when content scrolls behind
Use glass for floating action buttons or map filters overlay
Use glass for sticky header rows in the map view
dont's: Do not use glass on dense data dashboard cards
Do not use glass for text input fields

screens.name: Role Selection / Auth
screens.purpose: Securely authenticate and route users based on role (Cleaner, Owner, Client).
screens.layout: Hero image taking top 40% with top-down gradient scrim. Brand logo. Clean stacked buttons for Google SignIn and Email Auth. Minimalist and trustworthy.

screens.name: Live Map (Owner & Cleaner)
screens.purpose: A hardware-accelerated 60fps map displaying assigned/available jobs as color-coded status pins (Red, Yellow, Green).

states.loading: Map skeleton or blurred map tile with spinner.
states.empty: Map centers on current location with 'No active jobs' floating pill.

screens.layout: Full screen map taking 80% space. Floating top bar for filters (Date, Status). Bottom sheet for 'Up Next' or selected pin quick-card peek. Tapping a pin highlights it and peeks a card without a full screen change.

screens.name: Dashboard (Cleaner / Owner / Client)
screens.purpose: Role-specific command center: Cleaners see schedule/earnings, Owners see teams/jobs, Clients review cleaners.

states.empty: Illustration + 'No upcoming jobs. Post a job or find one.'

screens.layout: Vertical scroll. 'Today's Agenda' stacked cards. Use 'surfaceSecondary' for cards. Primary CTA ('Post Job' or 'Accept Job') is sticky at the bottom.

screens.name: Job Detail & Checklist
screens.purpose: Detailed work scope, notes, and the mandatory check-in/photo capture flow for standard/deep/airbnb cleans.
screens.layout: Top section: Address, Time window, Notes. Mid section: Sticky segmented control (Info | Checklist). Checklist view has oversized photo placeholder buttons. Sticky 'Complete Job' CTA at bottom disabled until photos are captured.

screens.name: Chat (1:1 & Team)
screens.purpose: In-app messaging to coordinate between owners, clients, and cleaners.
screens.layout: Standard chat interface. Input fixed to keyboard avoiding view. Avatar photos for users.

instructions_to_main_agent: Apply '1 iOS-Native Clean' personality with the exact color tokens mapped to the user's requested palette: Dark navy (#0A192F for text/dark mode surface), Dark teal (brand), Greige (light surface/borders), Gold (warning/secondary), Light Sage Green (tertiary).

Map View Guidelines: Use 'react-native-maps'. Pin status colors are critical: Red=Pending (error token), Yellow/Gold=In progress (warning/brandSecondary token), Green=Completed (success token). Implement bottom-sheet peek for selected pins.

Checklist View: For the mandatory photo requirements, ensure placeholders are large and obvious (min height 120pt). The 'Complete Job' button must be fixed to the bottom and remain disabled until all required photos are taken.
Visual Hierarchy: Use Dark Navy instead of pure black for all primary text (`onSurface`) and deep dark mode backgrounds to maintain a premium feel.
Use Phosphor icons consistently, with a unified weight (e.g., regular). Only use filled icons for active states (like tab bars).
